overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.description: +30% Grass damage while below half HP.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.description: +30% Fire damage while below half HP.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.description: +30% Water damage while below half HP.

static.name: Static
static.description: Pokémon that hit it in melee become Paralyzed.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.description: Once per battle, survives a knockout blow with 1 HP.

keen-eye.name: Keen Eye
keen-eye.description: Can target Pokémon hidden in tall grass from range.

poison-point.name: Poison Point
poison-point.description: Pokémon that hit it in melee become Poisoned.

effect-spore.name: Effect Spore
effect-spore.description: Grass moves also Poison the target.

anger-point.name: Anger Point
anger-point.description: +1 Attack each time it takes damage (max +3, this battle).

arena-trap.name: Arena Trap
arena-trap.description: Enemies that start their turn next to it cannot move.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: +30% Bug damage while below half HP.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.description: Floats above the ground: Slow never applies.

cute-charm.name: Cute Charm
cute-charm.description: Pokémon that hit it in melee are charmed: Slow for 1 turn.

flame-body.name: Flame Body
flame-body.description: Pokémon that hit it in melee become Burned.

guts.name: Guts
guts.description: +30% damage while it carries a status.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.description: Can't be charmed: Slow never applies.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.description: Can't be put to sleep: immune to Freeze.

water-absorb.name: Water Absorb
water-absorb.description: Heals 5% of max HP at the start of each of its turns.

sand-veil.name: Sand Veil
sand-veil.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

compound-eyes.name: Compound Eyes
compound-eyes.description: +1 max range on moves that reach 2+ tiles.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.description: +1 Attack each time it knocks out a foe (max +3, this battle).
